history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and loose-fitting grey jeans, leans casually against a metal railing. He is positioned on a paved walkway overlooking a beach at dusk. The ocean stretches out behind him, with gentle waves and distant lights twinkling along the coastline. Rocks are visible beneath the railing, and the sky is a deep, dark blue, indicating the transition from evening to night. The lighting is soft and atmospheric, casting a subtle glow on the man and the surrounding environment. The overall mood is tranquil and contemplative, with a touch of urban cool. The color palette is dominated by blues, greys, and blacks, with the white sneakers of the man providing a small contrast.
